about.title: About Me
about.bio: I am a Software Development student passionate about building systems that solve real-world problems. I specialize in backend development with Java and relational databases — writing raw SQL without ORMs because I believe understanding the fundamentals matters. I am looking for a place where I can contribute from day one and keep growing as part of a team.
